stories.title: Disposable barbecues temporarily banned from sale in Flintshire shops
stories.summary: Shops in Flintshire that keep selling disposable barbecues during the drought will be in breach of product safety law, and can be prosecuted. stories.title: Home Office pauses Gronant asylum housing plan after MP meeting
stories.summary: The Home Office says it is listening to local concerns to reduce the impact of asylum housing on communities like Gronant following strong local opposition. Residents of the Flintshire village have been caught in a whirlwind in the week since plans to move migrants awaiting asylum decisions into the 13 properties at the redeveloped  Gronant

stories.title: North Wales firefighters deployed to help tackle wildfires across Wales
stories.summary: Firefighters and resources from North Wales have been deployed to help tackle major wildfires burning across other parts of Wales.
